openscale.description:
openScale is a free, open-source Android app for tracking weight, body composition, and other health-related measurements. Designed with privacy in mind, it works entirely offline and lets you manage your personal measurements without creating an account or relying on cloud storage.

Connect compatible Bluetooth smart scales from manufacturers including Xiaomi, Beurer, Sanitas, Yunmai, Renpho, and others, or enter measurements manually. Track weight, BMI, body fat, muscle mass, body water, bone mass, body circumferences, and additional customizable metrics.

Explore your progress using interactive charts, statistical summaries, configurable insights, and measurement tables. Set personal goals, select your preferred measurement units, and customize which metrics appear. Multiple user profiles, home-screen widgets, CSV import and export, and light and dark themes make the app adaptable to different needs.

openScale does not contain advertisements and its main application does not request internet access. Optional synchronization is available through the separate openScale sync project.

Bluetooth compatibility varies by scale model, and body-composition estimates are not a substitute for medical measurements.
